title: Scholarships: ACR Office support
summary: AMCM, ESS and living-expense support (SLE 1/2/3) for B.Tech students, with contacts.

posts.md:
**ACR Office Scholarships**

The scholarship support currently provided includes:

**1. Tuition Fee Assistance**
For students whose parental income falls within:
- ₹1–5 Lakhs per annum
- ₹5–8 Lakhs per annum

**2. Living Expense Support**
For:
- Students with parental income below ₹1 Lakh per annum
- PwD students with parental income below ₹8 Lakhs per annum
- SC/ST students with parental income below ₹8 Lakhs per annum

**Note:** The scholarship details provided by the ACR Office currently cover **B.Tech students**.

** Scholarship Details**

**1. Alumni Merit-cum-Means Scholarship (AMCM)**

- Parental income: ₹1–5 Lakhs per annum
- Support: ₹66,666 per year
- Tuition assistance for up to 4 years
- Minimum CGPA: 6.5 for renewal
- Students should not be receiving any other scholarship

**2. Extended Support Scheme Endowment (ESS)**

- Parental income: ₹5–8 Lakhs per annum
- Support: ₹2,00,000 per year
- Tuition assistance for up to 4 years
- Minimum CGPA: 6.5 for renewal
- Students should not be receiving any other scholarship

**3. Support for Living Expenses – PwD (SLE 1)**

- PwD students
- Parental income: below ₹8 Lakhs per annum
- Support: ₹1,00,000 per year
- Minimum CGPA: 5.0 for renewal
- Valid disability certificate required

**4. Support for Living Expenses – SC/ST (SLE 2)**

- SC/ST students
- Parental income: up to ₹8 Lakhs per annum
- Support: ₹1,00,000 per year
- Minimum CGPA: 5.0 for renewal
- Annual income certificate required

**5. Support for Living Expenses – Below ₹1L (SLE 3)**

- Parental income: below ₹1 Lakh per annum
- Support: ₹1,00,000 per year
- Minimum CGPA: 5.0 for renewal
- Annual income certificate required

**Important:** These scholarship details are currently for **B.Tech students**. Please refer to the official ACR Office communication for the latest eligibility requirements and application process.

**Contact & Enquiries**

For scholarship-related queries:

- **Email:** [deanacr@iitm.ac.in](mailto:deanacr@iitm.ac.in)

**Office:** ACR Office, **2nd Floor, IC&SR Building**

It is recommended to **visit the ACR Office directly** for scholarship-related queries and assistance.
